name: io.github.smeet666/mcp-stashbox
description: Search scenes, performers, studios and tags across the public stash-box catalogues.

environmentVariables.name: STASHBOX_STASHDB_KEY
environmentVariables.description: API key for StashDB. A catalogue with no key is named as absent from every answer.

environmentVariables.name: STASHBOX_TPDB_KEY
environmentVariables.description: API key for ThePornDB. A catalogue with no key is named as absent from every answer.

environmentVariables.name: STASHBOX_FANSDB_KEY
environmentVariables.description: API key for FansDB. A catalogue with no key is named as absent from every answer.

environmentVariables.name: STASHBOX_PMV_KEY
environmentVariables.description: API key for PMV Stash. A catalogue with no key is named as absent from every answer.

environmentVariables.name: STASHBOX_JAVSTASH_KEY
environmentVariables.description: API key for JAVStash. A catalogue with no key is named as absent from every answer.

environmentVariables.name: SB_USER_AGENT
environmentVariables.description: Identify your own client. This project's identifier and a contact address stay appended, so a catalogue can always reach a human.

environmentVariables.name: SB_MIN_INTERVAL_MS
environmentVariables.description: Minimum milliseconds between requests to one catalogue. Default and floor 1000, ceiling 60000. The floor cannot be lowered.

environmentVariables.name: SB_TIMEOUT_MS
environmentVariables.description: Deadline for one request, in milliseconds. Default 20000.

environmentVariables.name: SB_MAX_RETRIES
environmentVariables.description: Retries on a busy catalogue. Default 3.

environmentVariables.name: SB_CACHE_TTL_MS
environmentVariables.description: In-memory cache lifetime, in milliseconds. Default 300000. Set 0 to turn it off.

environmentVariables.name: SB_CACHE_MAX_ENTRIES
environmentVariables.description: In-memory cache size, in entries. Default 500.

environmentVariables.name: SB_LOG_LEVEL
environmentVariables.description: error, info or debug. Default error. Logs go to stderr.
